title: SOYBEAN sowing advisory for central india
seed_rate: 70-80 kg/ha with Rhizobium + PSB seed treatment
fertilizer_recommendation: NPK 30:60:40 kg/ha as basal; nitrogen fixation supports N need.

content: SOYBEAN in central india should follow stage-wise agronomic operations. Sowing window: June-July. Seed rate: 70-80 kg/ha with Rhizobium + PSB seed treatment. Spacing: 45 cm x 5-7 cm.
